verses.original: Ἐν ἔτει δὲ πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ τῆς ἡγεμονίας Τιβερίου Καίσαρος ἡγεμονεύοντος Ποντίου Πιλάτου τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Γαλιλαίας Ἡρῴδου Φιλίππου δὲ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Ἰτουραίας καὶ Τραχωνίτιδος χώρας καὶ Λυσανίου τῆς Ἀβιληνῆς τετρααρχοῦντος
verses.transliteration: En etei de pentekaidekatō tēs hēgemonias Tiberiou Kaisaros hēgemoneuontos Pontiou Pilatou tēs Ioudaias kai tetraarchountos tēs Galilaias Hērōdou Philippou de tou adelphou autou tetraarchountos tēs Itouraias kai Trachōnitidos chōras kai Lysaniou tēs Abilēnēs tetraarchountos
verses.literal: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar while Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea Herod tetrarch of Galilee his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and Trachonitis and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene
verses.literalPt: E NO ano quinze do império de Tibério César, sendo Pôncio Pilatos presidente da Judéia, e Herodes tetrarca da Galiléia, e seu irmão Filipe tetrarca da Ituréia e da província de Traconites, e Lisânias tetrarca de Abilene,

verses.original: ἐπὶ ἀρχιερέως Ἅννα καὶ Καϊάφα ἐγένετο ῥῆμα Θεοῦ ἐπὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν Ζαχαρίου υἱὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: epi archiereōs Hanna kai Kaiapha egeneto rhēma Theou epi Iōannēn ton Zachariou huion en tē erēmō
verses.literal: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Sendo Anás e Caifás sumos sacerdotes, veio no deserto a palavra de Deus a João, filho de Zacarias.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν περίχωρον τοῦ Ἰορδάνου κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai ēlthen eis pasan tēn perichōron tou Iordanou kēryssōn baptisma metanoias eis aphesin hamartiōn
verses.literal: He went into all the region around the Jordan preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins
verses.literalPt: E percorreu toda a terra ao redor do Jordão, pregando o batismo de arrependimento, para o perdão dos pecados;

verses.original: ὡς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ λόγων Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hōs gegraptai en biblō logōn Ēsaiou tou prophētou Phōnē boōntos en tē erēmō Hetoimasate tēn hodon Kyriou eutheias poieite tas tribous autou
verses.literal: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet A voice of one calling in the wilderness Prepare the way for the Lord make straight paths for Him
verses.literalPt: Segundo o que está escrito no livro das palavras do profeta Isaías, que diz: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor; Endireitai as suas veredas.

verses.original: πᾶσα φάραγξ πληρωθήσεται καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ βουνὸς ταπεινωθήσεται καὶ ἔσται τὰ σκολιὰ εἰς εὐθείαν καὶ αἱ τραχεῖαι εἰς ὁδοὺς λείας
verses.transliteration: pasa pharanx plērōthēsetai kai pan oros kai bounos tapeinōthēsetai kai estai ta skolia eis eutheian kai hai tracheiai eis hodous leias
verses.literal: Every valley shall be filled in and every mountain and hill made low The crooked ways shall be made . . . straight and the rough ways smooth
verses.literalPt: Todo o vale se encherá, E se abaixará todo o monte e outeiro; E o que é tortuoso se endireitará, E os caminhos escabrosos se aplanarão;

verses.original: καὶ ὄψεται πᾶσα σὰρξ τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai opsetai pasa sarx to sōtērion tou Theou
verses.literal: And all humanity will see - God’s salvation
verses.literalPt: E toda a carne verá a salvação de Deus.

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν οὖν τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ὄχλοις βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς
verses.transliteration: Elegen oun tois ekporeuomenois ochlois baptisthēnai hyp’ autou Gennēmata echidnōn tis hypedeixen hymin phygein apo tēs mellousēs orgēs
verses.literal: Then John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him You brood of vipers who warned you to flee from the coming wrath
verses.literalPt: Dizia, pois, João à multidão que saía para ser batizada por ele: Raça de víboras, quem vos ensinou a fugir da ira que está para vir?

verses.original: ποιήσατε οὖν καρποὺς ἀξίους τῆς μετανοίας καὶ μὴ ἄρξησθε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ
verses.transliteration: poiēsate oun karpous axious tēs metanoias kai mē arxēsthe legein en heautois Patera echomen ton Abraam legō gar hymin hoti dynatai ho Theos ek tōn lithōn toutōn egeirai tekna tō Abraam
verses.literal: Produce fruit then in keeping with repentance And do not begin to say to yourselves We have Abraham as our father For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham
verses.literalPt: Produzi, pois, frutos dignos de arrependimento, e não comeceis a dizer em vós mesmos: Temos Abraão por pai; porque eu vos digo que até destas pedras pode Deus suscitar filhos a Abraão.

verses.original: ἤδη δὲ καὶ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται
verses.transliteration: ēdē de kai hē axinē pros tēn rhizan tōn dendrōn keitai pan oun dendron mē poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eis pyr balletai
verses.literal: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire
verses.literalPt: E também já está posto o machado à raiz das árvores; toda a árvore, pois, que não dá bom fruto, corta-se e lança-se no fogo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ ὄχλοι λέγοντες Τί οὖν ποιήσωμεν
verses.transliteration: Kai epērōtōn auton hoi ochloi legontes Ti oun poiēsōmen
verses.literal: The crowds asked him What then should we do
verses.literalPt: E a multidão o interrogava, dizendo: Que faremos, pois?

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ὁ ἔχων δύο χιτῶνας μεταδότω τῷ μὴ ἔχοντι καὶ ὁ ἔχων βρώματα ὁμοίως ποιείτω
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de elegen autois Ho echōn dyo chitōnas metadotō tō mē echonti kai ho echōn brōmata homoiōs poieitō
verses.literal: John replied . . . . . . Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none and whoever has food should do the same
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Quem tiver duas túnicas, reparta com o que não tem, e quem tiver alimentos, faça da mesma maneira.

verses.original: Ἦλθον δὲ καὶ τελῶναι βαπτισθῆναι καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν Διδάσκαλε τί ποιήσωμεν
verses.transliteration: Ēlthon de kai telōnai baptisthēnai kai eipan pros auton Didaskale ti poiēsōmen
verses.literal: Even tax collectors came to be baptized Teacher they asked - what should we do
verses.literalPt: E chegaram também uns publicanos, para serem batizados, e disseram-lhe: Mestre, que devemos fazer?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Μηδὲν πλέον παρὰ τὸ διατεταγμένον ὑμῖν πράσσετε
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen pros autous Mēden pleon para to diatetagmenon hymin prassete
verses.literal: Collect no more than . . . you are authorized - he answered
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Não peçais mais do que o que vos está ordenado.

verses.original: Ἐπηρώτων δὲ αὐτὸν καὶ στρατευόμενοι λέγοντες Τί ποιήσωμεν καὶ ἡμεῖς Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Μηδένα διασείσητε μηδὲ συκοφαντήσητε καὶ ἀρκεῖσθε τοῖς ὀψωνίοις ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Epērōtōn de auton kai strateuomenoi legontes Ti poiēsōmen kai hēmeis Kai eipen autois Mēdena diaseisēte mēde sykophantēsēte kai arkeisthe tois opsōniois hymōn
verses.literal: Then . . . some soldiers asked him And what should we do Do not take money by force . . . or false accusation he said . . . Be content with your wages
verses.literalPt: E uns soldados o interrogaram também, dizendo: E nós que faremos? E ele lhes disse: A ninguém trateis mal nem defraudeis, e contentai-vos com o vosso soldo.

verses.original: Προσδοκῶντος δὲ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ διαλογιζομένων πάντων ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν περὶ τοῦ Ἰωάννου μή‿ ποτε αὐτὸς εἴη ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: Prosdokōntos de tou laou kai dialogizomenōn pantōn en tais kardiais autōn peri tou Iōannou mē pote autos eiē ho Christos
verses.literal: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts - if . . . John could be the Christ
verses.literalPt: E, estando o povo em expectação, e pensando todos de João, em seus corações, se porventura seria o Cristo,

verses.original: ἀπεκρίνατο λέγων πᾶσιν ὁ Ἰωάννης Ἐγὼ μὲν ὕδατι βαπτίζω ὑμᾶς ἔρχεται δὲ ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί
verses.transliteration: apekrinato legōn pasin ho Iōannēs Egō men hydati baptizō hymas erchetai de ho ischyroteros mou hou ouk eimi hikanos lysai ton himanta tōn hypodēmatōn autou autos hymas baptisei en Pneumati Hagiō kai pyri
verses.literal: John answered all of them I baptize you with water but One more powerful than I will come the straps of whose . . . sandals I am not worthy to untie He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire
verses.literalPt: Respondeu João a todos, dizendo: Eu, na verdade, batizo-vos com água, mas eis que vem aquele que é mais poderoso do que eu, do qual não sou digno de desatar a correia das alparcas; esse vos batizará com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.

verses.original: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ διακαθᾶραι τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ συναγαγεῖν τὸν σῖτον εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην αὐτοῦ τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ
verses.transliteration: hou to ptyon en tē cheiri autou diakatharai tēn halōna autou kai synagagein ton siton eis tēn apothēkēn autou to de achyron katakausei pyri asbestō
verses.literal: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His barn but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire
verses.literalPt: Ele tem a pá na sua mão; e limpará a sua eira, e ajuntará o trigo no seu celeiro, mas queimará a palha com fogo que nunca se apaga.

verses.original: Πολλὰ μὲν οὖν καὶ ἕτερα παρακαλῶν εὐηγγελίζετο τὸν λαόν
verses.transliteration: Polla men oun kai hetera parakalōn euēngelizeto ton laon
verses.literal: With these and many other exhortations John proclaimed the good news to the people
verses.literalPt: E assim, admoestando-os, muitas outras coisas também anunciava ao povo.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης ἐλεγχόμενος ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ περὶ Ἡρῳδιάδος τῆς γυναικὸς τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν πονηρῶν ὁ Ἡρῴδης
verses.transliteration: ho de Hērōdēs ho tetraarchēs elenchomenos hyp’ autou peri Hērōdiados tēs gynaikos tou adelphou autou kai peri pantōn hōn epoiēsen ponērōn ho Hērōdēs
verses.literal: But when he rebuked . . . . . . Herod the tetrarch regarding his brother’s wife Herodias and all the evils - he had done
verses.literalPt: Sendo, porém, o tetrarca Herodes repreendido por ele por causa de Herodias, mulher de seu irmão Filipe, e por todas as maldades que Herodes tinha feito,

verses.original: προσέθηκεν καὶ τοῦτο ἐπὶ πᾶσιν καὶ κατέκλεισεν τὸν Ἰωάννην ἐν φυλακῇ
verses.transliteration: prosethēken kai touto epi pasin kai katekleisen ton Iōannēn en phylakē
verses.literal: Herod added this to them all He locked John up in prison
verses.literalPt: Acrescentou a todas as outras ainda esta, a de encerrar João num cárcere.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ βαπτισθῆναι ἅπαντα τὸν λαὸν καὶ Ἰησοῦ βαπτισθέντος καὶ προσευχομένου ἀνεῳχθῆναι τὸν οὐρανὸν
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de en tō baptisthēnai hapanta ton laon kai Iēsou baptisthentos kai proseuchomenou aneōchthēnai ton ouranon
verses.literal: When . . . . . . all the people were being baptized Jesus was baptized too And as He was praying heaven was opened
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, como todo o povo se batizava, sendo batizado também Jesus, orando ele, o céu se abriu;

verses.original: καὶ καταβῆναι τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον σωματικῷ εἴδει ὡς περιστερὰν ἐπ’ αὐτόν καὶ φωνὴν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ γενέσθαι Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα
verses.transliteration: kai katabēnai to Pneuma to Hagion sōmatikō eidei hōs peristeran ep’ auton kai phōnēn ex ouranou genesthai Sy ei ho Huios mou ho agapētos en soi eudokēsa
verses.literal: and the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove And a voice came from heaven You are My beloved Son in You I am well pleased
verses.literalPt: E o Espírito Santo desceu sobre ele em forma corpórea, como pomba; e ouviu-se uma voz do céu, que dizia: Tu és o meu Filho amado, em ti me comprazo.

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν Ἰησοῦς ἀρχόμενος ὡσεὶ ἐτῶν τριάκοντα Ὢν υἱός ὡς ἐνομίζετο Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἠλὶ
verses.transliteration: Kai autos ēn Iēsous archomenos hōsei etōn triakonta Ōn huios hōs enomizeto Iōsēph tou Ēli
verses.literal: Jesus Himself was about thirty years old when He began His ministry He was regarded as the son of Joseph the son of Heli
verses.literalPt: E o mesmo Jesus começava a ser de quase trinta anos, sendo (como se cuidava) filho de José, e José de Heli,

verses.original: τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἰανναὶ τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ
verses.transliteration: tou Maththat tou Leui tou Melchi tou Iannai tou Iōsēph
verses.literal: the son of Matthat the son of Levi the son of Melchi the son of Jannai the son of Joseph
verses.literalPt: E Heli de Matã, e Matã de Levi, e Levi de Melqui, e Melqui de Janai, e Janai de José,

verses.original: τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Ἀμὼς τοῦ Ναοὺμ τοῦ Ἑσλὶ τοῦ Ναγγαὶ
verses.transliteration: tou Mattathiou tou Amōs tou Naoum tou Hesli tou Nangai
verses.literal: the son of Mattathias the son of Amos the son of Nahum the son of Esli the son of Naggai
verses.literalPt: E José de Matatias, e Matatias de Amós, e Amós de Naum, e Naum de Esli, e Esli de Nagaí,

verses.original: τοῦ Μαὰθ τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Σεμεῒν τοῦ Ἰωσὴχ τοῦ Ἰωδὰ
verses.transliteration: tou Maath tou Mattathiou tou Semein tou Iōsēch tou Iōda
verses.literal: the son of Maath the son of Mattathias the son of Semein the son of Josech the son of Joda
verses.literalPt: E Nagaí de Máate, e Máate de Matatias, e Matatias de Semei, e Semei de José, e José de Jodá,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰωανὰν τοῦ Ῥησὰ τοῦ Ζοροβάβελ τοῦ Σαλαθιὴλ τοῦ Νηρὶ
verses.transliteration: tou Iōanan tou Rhēsa tou Zorobabel tou Salathiēl tou Nēri
verses.literal: the son of Joanan the son of Rhesa the son of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel the son of Neri
verses.literalPt: E Jodá de Joanã, e Joanã de Resá, e Resá de Zorobabel, e Zorobabel de Salatiel, e Salatiel de Neri,

verses.original: τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἀδδὶ τοῦ Κωσὰμ τοῦ Ἐλμαδὰμ τοῦ Ἢρ
verses.transliteration: tou Melchi tou Addi tou Kōsam tou Elmadam tou Ēr
verses.literal: the son of Melchi the son of Addi the son of Cosam the son of Elmadam the son of Er
verses.literalPt: E Neri de Melqui, e Melqui de Adi, e Adi de Cosã, e Cosã de Elmadã, e Elmadã de Er,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ἐλιέζερ τοῦ Ἰωρὶμ τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ
verses.transliteration: tou Iēsou tou Eliezer tou Iōrim tou Maththat tou Leui
verses.literal: the son of Joshua the son of Eliezer the son of Jorim the son of Matthat the son of Levi
verses.literalPt: E Er de Josué, e Josué de Eliézer, e Eliézer de Jorim, e Jorim de Matã, e Matã de Levi,

verses.original: τοῦ Συμεὼν τοῦ Ἰούδα τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἰωνὰμ τοῦ Ἐλιακὶμ
verses.transliteration: tou Symeōn tou Iouda tou Iōsēph tou Iōnam tou Eliakim
verses.literal: the son of Simeon the son of Judah the son of Joseph the son of Jonam the son of Eliakim
verses.literalPt: E Levi de Simeão, e Simeão de Judá, e Judá de José, e José de Jonã, e Jonã de Eliaquim,

verses.original: τοῦ Μελεὰ τοῦ Μεννὰ τοῦ Ματταθὰ τοῦ Ναθὰμ τοῦ Δαυὶδ
verses.transliteration: tou Melea tou Menna tou Mattatha tou Natham tou Dauid
verses.literal: the son of Melea the son of Menna the son of Mattatha the son of Nathan the son of David
verses.literalPt: E Eliaquim de Meleá, e Meleá de Mená, e Mená de Matatá, e Matatá de Natã, e Natã de Davi,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰεσσαὶ τοῦ Ἰωβὴδ τοῦ Βοὸς τοῦ Σαλὰ τοῦ Ναασσὼν
verses.transliteration: tou Iessai tou Iōbēd tou Boos tou Sala tou Naassōn
verses.literal: the son of Jesse the son of Obed the son of Boaz the son of Sala the son of Nahshon
verses.literalPt: E Davi de Jessé, e Jessé de Obede, e Obede de Boaz, e Boaz de Salá, e Salá de Naassom,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἀμιναδὰβ τοῦ Ἀδμὶν τοῦ Ἀρνὶ τοῦ Ἑσρὼμ τοῦ Φαρὲς τοῦ Ἰούδα
verses.transliteration: tou Aminadab tou Admin tou Arni tou Hesrōm tou Phares tou Iouda
verses.literal: the son of Amminadab the son of Admin the son of Arni the son of Hezron the son of Perez the son of Judah
verses.literalPt: E Naassom de Aminadabe, e Aminadabe de Arão, e Arão de Esrom, e Esrom de Perez, e Perez de Judá,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰακὼβ τοῦ Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ τοῦ Θάρα τοῦ Ναχὼρ
verses.transliteration: tou Iakōb tou Isaak tou Abraam tou Thara tou Nachōr
verses.literal: the son of Jacob the son of Isaac the son of Abraham the son of Terah the son of Nahor
verses.literalPt: E Judá de Jacó, e Jacó de Isaque, e Isaque de Abraão, e Abraão de Terá, e Terá de Nacor,

verses.original: τοῦ Σεροὺχ τοῦ Ῥαγαῦ τοῦ Φάλεκ τοῦ Ἔβερ τοῦ Σαλὰ
verses.transliteration: tou Serouch tou Rhagau tou Phalek tou Eber tou Sala
verses.literal: the son of Serug the son of Reu the son of Peleg the son of Eber the son of Shelah
verses.literalPt: E Nacor de Seruque, e Seruque de Ragaú, e Ragaú de Fáleque, e Fáleque de Éber, e Éber de Salá,

verses.original: τοῦ Καϊνὰμ τοῦ Ἀρφαξὰδ τοῦ Σὴμ τοῦ Νῶε τοῦ Λάμεχ
verses.transliteration: tou Kainam tou Arphaxad tou Sēm tou Nōe tou Lamech
verses.literal: the son of Cainan the son of Arphaxad the son of Shem the son of Noah the son of Lamech
verses.literalPt: E Salá de Cainã, e Cainã de Arfaxade, e Arfaxade de Sem, e Sem de Noé, e Noé de Lameque,

verses.original: τοῦ Μαθουσαλὰ τοῦ Ἑνὼχ τοῦ Ἰάρετ τοῦ Μαλελεὴλ τοῦ Καϊνὰμ
verses.transliteration: tou Mathousala tou Henōch tou Iaret tou Maleleēl tou Kainam
verses.literal: the son of Methuselah the son of Enoch the son of Jared the son of Mahalalel the son of Cainan
verses.literalPt: E Lameque de Matusalém, e Matusalém de Enoque, e Enoque de Jarete, e Jarete de Maleleel, e Maleleel de Cainã,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἐνὼς τοῦ Σὴθ τοῦ Ἀδὰμ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: tou Enōs tou Sēth tou Adam tou Theou
verses.literal: the son of Enosh the son of Seth the son of Adam the son of God
verses.literalPt: E Cainã de Enos, e Enos de Sete, e Sete de Adão, e Adão de Deus.
